notes: The reported year-end cash floor. The anchor model draws the revolver to hold this balance at 31 December and the source generator lands on the same anchored balance.
Above this level surplus cash is applied to the revolver before any voluntary term-loan prepayment.

The operating floor treasury manages to during the year. It is below the reported year-end floor because a month end inside the year carries no reporting obligation. Scaled by monthly trading activity.

parameter: Liquidity headroom above the operating floor
notes: A borrowing notice is not submitted for the exact shortfall; it is submitted for the shortfall plus working headroom.
Drawings are requested in multiples of USD 0.5m.
Repayments are made in blocks of USD 2.5m, and only once the surplus is worth applying.
No treasurer repays half a million and redraws it a month later. Below this surplus the balance is left drawn.
Two business days' notice. Funds are drawn ahead of the supplier payment run and the payroll disbursement, so a month that draws is drawn for substantially the whole month.
Surplus collections are applied to the facility once the month's receipts have cleared, so a month that repays is drawn for most of the month and repaid only at the end.
Interest accrues on the daily drawn balance, actual days over a 365-day year, and is settled quarterly in arrears.
The commitment fee accrues on the daily undrawn commitment, so it is the mirror of the drawn balance and not an independent assumption.
